#.label: Adyen (cloud) – terminals (preview)
Register the Adyen terminal used at a ch: Register the Adyen terminal used at a checkout. Set this on one checkout at a time, because each checkout has its own terminal. The Adyen account details come from “Adyen (cloud) – account”.
#/properties/terminalId.label: Terminal ID
#/properties/terminalId.description: Adyen's ID for the terminal at this checkout, for example e285p-123456789, as shown in your Adyen customer area.
#/properties/transactionRouting.label: How the payment reaches the terminal
#/properties/transactionRouting.descript: CLOUD: the payment goes through Adyen's cloud to the terminal, which needs an internet connection. LOCAL_APP: the payment is handed to the Adyen Payments app on this checkout's Android device, for example for Tap to Pay.
LOCAL_APP also needs the “Tap to Pay” se: LOCAL_APP also needs the “Tap to Pay” section under “Adyen (cloud) – account” to be filled in.
